TABATABAI:42:13#3/r7.claim: The religion’s being burdensome to the polytheists means that they are reluctant to accept it.
TABATABAI:42:13#3/r7.anchor: والمراد بكبره على المشركين تحرجهم من قبوله

TABATABAI:42:13#3/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:42:13#3/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:42:13#3/r8.claim: Ijtibāʾ means to gather and draw someone near.

TABATABAI:42:13#3/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:42:13#3/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:42:13#3/r9.claim: The pronouns in ‘to it’ share an antecedent: the religion of divine unity, to which God draws whom He wills and guides whoever turns to Him.
TABATABAI:42:13#3/r9.anchor: ومقتضى اتساق الضمائر أن يكون ضمير { إليه } الثاني والثالث

TABATABAI:42:13-14/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r1.claim: The phrase echoes God’s choosing Abraham’s community and relieving it of hardship.
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r1.anchor: هو اجتباكم وما جعل عليكم في الدين من حرج ملة أبيكم إبراهيم

TABATABAI:42:13-14/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r2.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r2.claim: Another possible reading takes the pronouns as referring to God; al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī says the contextual reading is more fitting.
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r2.anchor: وقيل الضميران لله تعالى، ولا بأس به

TABATABAI:42:13-14/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r3.claim: God’s choosing and guiding whom He wills makes the faith of the arrogant polytheists unnecessary, as when disbelievers are contrasted with the angels’ worship.
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r3.anchor: قوله { الله يجتبي إليه } إلى آخر الآية موضوع موضع الاستغناء

TABATABAI:42:13-14/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r4.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r4.claim: Another view says the call is to belief in the Messenger and that his message troubled them; the author calls this contrary to the apparent sense.
TABATABAI:42:13-14/r4.anchor: وقيل المراد بما تدعوهم إليه ما تدعوهم إلى الإيمان به وهو الرسالة

AKHFASH:v2p510/r1.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v2p510/r1.speaker: author
AKHFASH:v2p510/r1.claim: He construes أن أقيموا الدين as an appositional explanation, effectively saying the command is to establish the religion.
AKHFASH:v2p510/r1.anchor: على التفسير كأنه قال "هو أن أقيموا الدين

TABRISI:42:12-14/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r4.claim: God clarified and laid out the religion of divine unity and disavowal of polytheism, prescribed to Noah and revealed to Muhammad and the other named prophets.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r4.anchor: أي بين لكم ونهج وأوضح من الدين والتوحيد والبراءة من الشرك ما وصى به نوحا

TABRISI:42:12-14/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r5.claim: Establishing religion means adhering to it, acting by its requirements, persisting in it, and calling others to it.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r5.anchor: إقامة الدين التمسك به والعمل بموجبه والدوام عليه والدعاء إليه

TABRISI:42:12-14/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r6.claim: They are told not to disagree in religion, but to unite and agree as God's brothers.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r6.anchor: ولا تتفرقوا أي ولا تختلفوا فيه وائتلفوا فيه واتفقوا وكونوا عباد الله إخوانا

TABRISI:42:12-14/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r7.claim: Tawhid, sincerity to God, rejecting idols, and leaving ancestral religion weighed heavily on polytheists; they resented Muhammad's selection for revelation and prophethood.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r7.anchor: من توحيد الله والإخلاص له ورفض الأوثان وترك دين الآباء لأنهم قالوا أجعل الآلهة إلها واحدا

TABRISI:42:12-14/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r8.claim: Selection is God's, not the polytheists': He chooses a messenger whom He knows can bear the mission, as He chose Muhammad and earlier prophets.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r8.anchor: أي ليس إليهم الاختيار لأن الله يصطفي لرسالته من يشاء على حسب ما يعلم من قيامه بأعباء الرسالة

TABRISI:42:12-14/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r9.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:42:12-14/r9.claim: An alternative gloss is that God selects whichever servants He wills for His religion.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r9.anchor: وقيل: معناه الله يصطفي من عباده لدينه من يشاء

TABRISI:42:12-14/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r10.claim: God guides to His religion those who turn to obey Him.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r10.anchor: أي ويرشد إلى دينه من يقبل إلى طاعته

TABRISI:42:12-14/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r11.speaker: author
TABRISI:42:12-14/r11.claim: The promise of guidance is compared with the statement that those already guided receive further guidance.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r11.anchor: وهذا كقوله والذين اهتدوا زادهم هدى

TABRISI:42:12-14/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:42:12-14/r12.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:42:12-14/r12.claim: Another interpretation is that God guides to His garden and reward whoever returns to Him with intention and sincerity.
TABRISI:42:12-14/r12.anchor: وقيل: يهدي إلى جنته وثوابه من يرجع إليه بالنية والإخلاص

THALABI:v8p305#2/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p305#2/r12.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p305#2/r12.claim: God prescribed for the community the religion He enjoined on Noah, whom Thaʿlabi calls the first prophet given a revealed law, and also revealed to Muhammad and enjoined on Abraham, Moses, and Jesus.
THALABI:v8p305#2/r12.anchor: شرع لكم من الدين ما وصى به نوحا وهو أول أنبياء الشريعة.

THALABI:v8p305#2/r13.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p305#2/r13.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v8p305#2/r13.claim: Qatada says the shared command is to permit what God made lawful and forbid what He made forbidden.
THALABI:v8p305#2/r13.anchor: فقال قتادة: تحليل الحلال وتحريم الحرام،

THALABI:v8p305#2/r14.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p305#2/r14.speaker: الحكم
THALABI:v8p305#2/r14.claim: Al-Hakam identifies the shared command as prohibiting sisters, mothers, and daughters.
THALABI:v8p305#2/r14.anchor: وقال الحكم: تحريم الأخوات والأمهات والبنات،

THALABI:v8p305#2/r15.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p305#2/r15.speaker: مجاهد
THALABI:v8p305#2/r15.claim: Mujahid says every prophet was commanded to establish prayer, give alms, and acknowledge obedience to God.
THALABI:v8p305#2/r15.anchor: وقال مجاهد: لم يبعث الله تعالى نبيا إلا أوصاه بإقامة الصلاة، وإيتاء الزكاة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r1.claim: God set out the religion for the community; waṣṣā means He commanded it to Noah.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r1.anchor: شرع لكم } بين وأظهر لكم { من الدين ما وصى به } أمر { نوحا

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r2.claim: All prophets are sent to establish the religion and avoid division.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r2.anchor: والله يبعث الأنبياء كلهم بإقامة الدين وترك الفرقة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r3.claim: The call to monotheism and abandoning idols is difficult and burdensome for the polytheists.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r3.anchor: كبر } عظم وشق { على المشركين ما تدعوهم إليه } من التوحيد وترك الأوثان

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r4.claim: God chooses whom He wills for His religion and guides that person to it.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:42:13-14/r4.anchor: الله يجتبي إليه من يشاء } يصطفي من يشاء لدينه، فيهديه إليه

ELMALILI:42:13-16/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r1.claim: God commands people in every age and community to unite in upholding the religion, meaning the law revealed for their time, without splitting over it.
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r1.anchor: dini ki o her zaman ve millette vaktin şer‘idir

ELMALILI:42:13-16/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r2.claim: He invokes the saying that God’s hand is with the community and the image of a wolf taking the sheep that separates from its flock.
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r2.anchor: Kurt da sürüden ayrılan koyunu yer

ELMALILI:42:13-16/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r3.claim: God is conceived as the one worthy of worship through His beautiful names; their multiplicity accompanies, rather than negates, unity of the divine essence.
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r3.anchor: Onun için esmâsının kesreti ile beraber aynını tevhid lâzımdır.

ELMALILI:42:13-16/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r4.speaker: Hukemâdan birisi
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r4.claim: A dying sage showed his children that a bundled sheaf of sticks could not be broken together, but the separated sticks broke one by one, illustrating the strength of unity.
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r4.anchor: Hukemâdan birisi vefat ederken evlâdına vasiyet etti bir cemaat idiler, ‘bana bir kucak değnek getirin’ dedi getirdiler.

ELMALILI:42:13-16/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r5.claim: Likewise, those who unite in establishing the religion cannot be overcome by an enemy, while division gives the enemy an opening to destroy them.
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r5.anchor: İkāme-i din hususunda ictimâ‘edip de dağılmadıkları takdirde düşman onlara kahredemez.

ELMALILI:42:13-16/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r6.claim: The same applies inwardly: when someone gathers their resolve to uphold God’s religion, devils from humans or jinn cannot defeat them against the aid of faith and the angels.
ELMALILI:42:13-16/r6.anchor: Nefsinde kendini toplayıp da Allah’ın dinini ikāmeye azmettiği vakit ne insten ne cinden bir şeytan vereceği vesvese ile onu imanın ve melekin müsâ‘adesi karşısında mağlup edemez.

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r1.claim: The call is to abandon idols, polytheism, and division, enter Islam through tawhid, and establish the religion rightly.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r1.anchor: o senin kendilerini davet edip durduğun şey o putlardan o şirk ve tefrikadan vazgeçip tevhid ile İslâm’a girmek, dini doğrultmak işi

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r2.claim: God selects whom He wills for His religion or for Himself.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r2.anchor: Allah ona: dinine veya kendisine dilediğini seçer, derer

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r3.claim: God grants success to whoever turns to Him and brings that person onto the right path.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r3.anchor: ve kim gönül verirse ona onu muvaffak kılar o doğru

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r4.claim: Division includes opposition to the prophets and later communities splitting the religion and fighting among themselves.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r4.anchor: gerek peygamberlere karşı ayrı baş tutarak muhalefet etmeleri, gerekse onların arkasından ümmetlerinin dinde tefrika çıkararak birbirleriyle uğraşmaları

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r7.claim: Knowledge by itself is insufficient to set people right.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r7.anchor: Demek ki ilim insanların salâhı için kâfi değildir.

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r8.claim: The commanding self has corrupt feelings that can openly drive people to do what they know is wrong.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r8.anchor: Nefs-i emmârenin öyle kötü hissiyâtı vardır ki insanları bildiklerinin hilâfına açık açık fenalıklara sevkeder

ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r9.claim: Moral reform therefore needs practical training to discipline feelings as well as knowledge; religious education has special importance in this respect.
ELMALILI:42:13-16#2/r9.anchor: ahlâk-ı beşerin ıslâhı işinde ilimden başka hissiyâtın tehzîbi için bir terbiye-i ameliye dahi lâzımdır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r1.speaker: Müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r1.claim: Nearly all exegetes understand dīn here broadly as all divinely revealed religions.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r1.anchor: Hemen bütün müfessirler burada din kelimesinin ilâhî dinlerin tamamını ifade eden geniş anlamıyla kullanıldığı kanaatindedirler.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r2.claim: Because laws were not identical across those religions and earlier practical rules were not all enacted for Muhammad’s community, this verse means their shared core.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r2.anchor: Bu dinlerdeki bütün hükümlerin diğerlerinde aynen korunmadığı ve önceki ilâhî dinlerde yer alan amelî hükümlerin hepsinin Hz. Muhammed’in ümmeti için teşrî‘ kılınmadığı da bilinmektedir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r3.claim: The shared religious core includes monotheism first, along with belief in angels, revelation and scriptures, prophethood, and the afterlife.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r3.anchor: Başta kuşkusuz tevhid inancı gelmektedir. Aynı şekilde meleklere, vahiy olgusuna (ilâhî kitaplara), peygamberlik müessesesine ve âhiret hayatına inanmak da ortak akîde esaslarındandır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r4.claim: Common teachings also include basic ethics and some practical rules such as prayer and prohibitions on marriage among close relatives, though details vary.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r4.anchor: temel ahlâk ilkeleri, –ayrıntılarında farklılıklar olsa da– namaz vecîbesi ve belirli yakınlık derecesinde olanların birbirleriyle evlenme yasağı

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r5.claim: The named prophets are pivotal links: Noah represents a beginning; Abraham revived monotheism amid polytheism and is ancestor of the three major extant religions; Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad are prophets of those religions.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r5.anchor: İnsanlık tarihinde önemli bir başlangıcı temsil eden Hz. Nûh, çok tanrıcı inançların her tarafı sardığı bir ortamda tek Tanrı inancının ihyası için görevlendirilen

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r6.speaker: Bazı İslâm âlimleri
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r6.claim: Some Muslim scholars interpret the “people of resolve” in 46:35 as the five prophets named here, who are also singled out in 33:7.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r6.anchor: bazı İslâm âlimleri Ahkaf sûresinde geçen “ülü’l-azm” tabiri ile, anılan beş peygamberin kastedildiği yorumunu yapmışlardır; bk. Ahkaf 46/35

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r7.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r7.claim: Muhammad is addressed as “you,” rather than named, because he is the direct addressee.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r7.anchor: Burada Resûl-i Ekrem kendisine hitap edilen olduğu için ismen değil, “sen” şeklinde muhatap olarak zikredilmiştir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r8.claim: The contrast between waṣṣā for what was enjoined on the other prophets and awḥā for what was revealed to Muhammad emphasizes his prophetic mission.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r8.anchor: diğer peygamberlere bildirilenler için “vassâ” fiili kullanıldığı halde, ona bildirilenler için “evhâ” fiili kullanılmıştır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r9.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r9.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r9.claim: It is striking that Muhammad, the final link in the revelation chain, is addressed immediately after Noah, who represents its beginning.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r9.anchor: Başlangıcı temsilen Hz. Nûh zikredildikten hemen sonra vahiy zincirinin son halkası olması itibariyle Hz. Muhammed’e hitap edilmesi ve ona vahyedilenden söz edilmesi de dikkat çekicidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r10.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r10.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r10.claim: “What We revealed to you” can refer to what had been revealed by the time this verse descended, or to everything revealed to the Prophet without qualification.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r10.anchor: Âyetin “sana vahyettiklerimizi” anlamına gelen kısmı, bu âyetin indiği zamana kadar Resûlullah’a vahyedilmiş olanlar veya mutlak olarak ona vahyedilenler şeklinde anlaşılabilir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r11.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r11.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r11.claim: After noting common beliefs and ethics, the verse stresses the essential means of preserving them: uphold the religion and do not divide over it.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r11.anchor: âyetin devamında bunların da varlığını korumasının vazgeçilmez şartı olan bir ilkeye vurgu yapılmaktadır: “... ki o dini ayakta tutasınız, o konuda tefrikaya düşmeyesiniz.”

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r12.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r12.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r12.claim: Another possible rendering is that the essence of these commands is caring for religion and not fragmenting over it.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r12.anchor: Âyetin bu kısmını “... ki bunların özü, dine özen gösterme ve o konuda parça parça olmama gereğidir” şeklinde tercüme etmek de mümkündür.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r13.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r13.speaker: Bazı müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r13.claim: Some exegetes take the unity command as a summary of what was enjoined on all the named prophets: establish religion and do not divide over it.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r13.anchor: Bazı müfessirler bu cümleyi anılan peygamberlere buyurulanların yerini tutacak tarzda açıklamışlardır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r14.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r14.speaker: Râzî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r14.claim: Razi explains the command not to divide as a prohibition against splitting through polytheistic beliefs.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r14.anchor: Râzî, parçalanmama buyruğunu “Çok tanrıcı inançlara saparak parçalanmayın” şeklinde açıklar

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r15.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r15.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r15.claim: The phrase is usually explained as the Meccan polytheists’ difficulty accepting the new religious call.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r15.anchor: “Kendilerini davet ettiğin bu din müşriklere ağır geldi” anlamındaki cümle müfessirlerce daha çok Mekke putperestlerinin yeni din çağrısını içlerine sindirememeleri olgusuyla açıklanır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r16.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r16.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r16.claim: The author suggests the call felt burdensome because a modest, nonwealthy man delivered it without an all-at-once book or spectacular angelic signs; its monotheism and afterlife message threatened the leaders’ polytheistic order and interests.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r16.anchor: Bu çağrının Hz. Muhammed gibi bir beşer tarafından, hele onların değer yargılarına göre toplumda üstün bir konuma (özellikle büyük bir servete) sahip olmayan

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r17.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r17.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r17.claim: The clause translated as God choosing whom he wills for the mission contains an implicit pronoun meaning “to it,” omitted from the translation.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r17.anchor: “Allah (dini tebliğ için) dilediğini seçer” şeklinde çevrilen cümlede “ona” anlamına gelen ve meâle yansıtılamayan bir zamir bulunmaktadır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r18.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r18.speaker: Taberî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r18.claim: Tabari and some exegetes understand the clause as God choosing those worthy of nearness, drawing them to himself and gathering them.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r18.anchor: seçilmeye lâyık olanları seçip kendisine yaklaştırır, onları nezdine celbeder, toplar” şeklinde açıklamışlardır (meselâ Taberî, XXV, 16)

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r19.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r19.speaker: Beyzâvî ve Hâzin
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r19.claim: Beyzavi, Khazin, and other exegetes take the pronoun to refer to the religion or the Prophet’s call: God chooses those worthy for the true religion.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:42:13/r19.anchor: “Lâyık olanları hak din için seçer” yorumunu yapmışlardır (meselâ bk. Beyzâvî, V, 401; Hâzin, V, 401)

ITQAN:v1p248/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p248/r1.claim: Some objected to imāla because of a report that the Qur'an came down with tafkhīm; one answer is that it was first revealed so, then imāla was permitted.
ITQAN:v1p248/r1.anchor: كره قوم الإمالة لحديث نزل القرآن بالتفخيم وأجيب عنه بأوجه أحدها أنه نزل بذلك ثم رخص في الإمالة

ITQAN:v1p248/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p248/r2.claim: Another answer takes tafkhīm to mean reciting in a masculine voice rather than softening one's voice like women.
ITQAN:v1p248/r2.anchor: ثانيها أن معناه أنه يقرأ على قراءة الرجال لا يخضع الصوت فيه ككلام النساء

ITQAN:v1p248/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r3.speaker: جمال القراء
ITQAN:v1p248/r3.claim: A third answer interprets the report as the Qur'an's forceful, severe impact on polytheists; Jamal al-Qurra calls this far-fetched because the Qur'an also came with mercy and compassion.
ITQAN:v1p248/r3.anchor: قال في جمال القراء وهو بعيد في تفسير الخبر لأنه نزل أيضا بالرحمة والرأفة

ITQAN:v1p248/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p248/r4.claim: Another answer understands tafkhīm as a call to magnify and revere the Qur'an.
ITQAN:v1p248/r4.anchor: رابعها أن معناه بالتعظيم والتبجيل أي عظموه وبجلوه فحض بذلك على تعظيم القرآن وتبجيله

ITQAN:v1p248/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r5.speaker: الداني
ITQAN:v1p248/r5.claim: Al-Dani prefers the fifth answer: tafkhīm means pronouncing medial letters with vowel movement in disputed places rather than leaving them quiescent, making them fuller and weightier.
ITQAN:v1p248/r5.anchor: قال الداني فهذا الوجه أولى في تفسير الخبر

ITQAN:v1p248/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
ITQAN:v1p248/r6.claim: Al-Dani says Ibn Abbas explained tafkhīm as the Qur'an being revealed with heaviness and full articulation, as in al-Jumʿa and similar words.
ITQAN:v1p248/r6.anchor: قال الداني وكذا جاء مفسرا عن ابن عباس ثم قال حدثنا ابن خاقان حدثنا أحمد بن محمد حدثنا علي بن عبد العزيز حدثنا القاسم سمعت الكسائي يخبر عن سلمان عن الزهري قال قال ابن عباس نزل القرآن بالتثقيل والتفخيم نحو قوله الجمعة

ITQAN:v1p248/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r7.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
ITQAN:v1p248/r7.claim: Al-Dani also cites al-Hakim's marfūʿ report from Zayd ibn Thabit that the Qur'an was revealed with tafkhīm; no grading is stated here.
ITQAN:v1p248/r7.anchor: ثم أورد حديث الحاكم عن زيد بن ثابت مرفوعا نزل القرآن بالتفخيم

ITQAN:v1p248/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r8.speaker: عمار
ITQAN:v1p248/r8.claim: Muhammad ibn Muqatil reports hearing Ammar cite عذرا أو نذرا and الصدفين as examples of medial-letter vowel movement.
ITQAN:v1p248/r8.anchor: وقال محمد بن مقاتل أحد رواته سمعت عمارا يقول ﴿ عذرا أو نذرا ﴾ و ﴿ الصدفين ﴾ يعني بتحريك الأوسط في ذلك

ITQAN:v1p248/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p248/r9.speaker: أبو عبيدة
ITQAN:v1p248/r9.claim: Abu Ubayda contrasts Hijaz and Najd: Hijazis generally use tafkhīm except in ʿashara, while Najdis usually leave it except for ʿashara with kasra.
ITQAN:v1p248/r9.anchor: قول أبي عبيدة أهل الحجاز يفخمون الكلام كله إلا حرفا واحدا عشرة فإنهم يجزمونه وأهل نجد يتركون التفخيم في الكلام إلا هذا الحرف فإنهم يقولون عشرة بالكسر

DAMGHANI:v1p442/r2.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p442/r2.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p442/r2.claim: من can be an extra connective particle; in 42:13 من الدين means the religion, as in examples where من is glossed away.
DAMGHANI:v1p442/r2.anchor: فوجه منها : من صلة . قوله تعالى فى سورة نوح

TABATABAI:4:113#4/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:4:113#4/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:4:113#4/r2.claim: Other verses describe God's communication to the Prophet as revelation, supporting the identification of this teaching with divine revelation.
TABATABAI:4:113#4/r2.anchor: ويظهر من جهة أخرى أن ذلك من قبيل الوحي والتكليم

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r2#2/f4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r2#2/f4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r2#2/f4.claim: The Quran uses waṣṣā (with gemination) for religious and moral matters, but awṣā for material matters such as inheritance.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r2#2/f4.anchor: فكل ما ورد فيه من (وصّى) بالتشديد فهو في الدين والأمور المعنوية، وكل ما ورد من (أوصى) فهو في الأمور المادية

SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p8/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p8/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p8/r3.claim: The more specific relative الذي is used for Muhammad's known, explained law; ما is used for earlier laws whose details are not known to us.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p8/r3.anchor: اختار الإسم الموصول (الذي) عندما ذكر شريعة محمد - صلى الله عليه وسلم - ولم يقل (وما أوحينا إليك)

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p459/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p459/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p459/r4.claim: The specific, familiar relative pronoun الذي marks the revealed law of Muhammad, while ما is used for earlier prophets whose laws are not known in detail.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p459/r4.anchor: لذا اختار سبحانه (ما) اسم الموصول غير المعرّف
